3617.title: Connect authentication and plugin assets
3617.rootCauseOneLine: Connect rejects cookieless plugin requests before host routing; sandbox-induced cookie omission remains unverified.
3617.proposedFix: Verify authenticated browser cookie behavior, then design scoped asset authorization without granting general host authority.
3617.caveats: Five characterization assertions passed in two clean checkouts; no browser, live plugin, or remote endpoint exercised.
